thread:
Carmen Li: dropping a compact pass for the three site paths (hosted / dedicated / private). Need the copy + routing locked for the launch posts and the webinar gating. Main ask: make it crystal where a visitor should click. Drafts uploaded: https://drive.google.com/mock-landing-ctas
Eli Novak: quick principle: reduce cognitive load. Use single-line subheads and a clear primary CTA per path. Hosted = instant trial; Dedicated = capacity planning; Private = compliance-first.
Samira Khan: CTA proposals: Hosted -> "Start instant trial"; Dedicated -> "Estimate capacity"; Private -> "Request private deployment demo". For inbound routing, each CTA must populate a hidden field with the deployment type and utm=launch_quarter.
Theo Brooks: routing snippet for ops:
```
/try?mode=hosted -> hub-form: trial-hosted (hidden: deploy=hosted, utm=launch_q2)
/try?mode=dedicated -> hub-form: lead-dedicated (fields: expected_qps, model_family, budget_range)
/contact?mode=private -> hub-form: enterprise-sales (fields: compliance_requirements, onprem, kms_required)
/webinar/register -> nurture:webinar-llm-scale-2026
```
Map answers to SFDC queues: trial-hosted -> PLG queue, lead-dedicated -> AE-dedicated, enterprise-sales -> AE-enterprise.
Liam O'Connor: For Dedicated make sure the form asks for "expected peak tokens/sec" and an optional checkbox "need burst / autoscale". That saves back-and-forth sizing emails.
Carmen Li: Benchmarks: can infra give a short 1-line stat for each path? Hosted: average p95 for small models; Dedicated: p99 SLA at X qps; Private: note that latency depends on customer infra but show sample numbers from our on-prem tests. We need these for the hero microcards.
Eli Novak: I'll pull p95/p99 and tokens/sec for a standard 2k seq test across three configs (open baseline, quantized, and optimized runtime) and write a one-line methodology. Will attach charts.
Samira Khan: Webinar gating idea: add a required question "Are you evaluating for production? (yes/no)" and a single-select "Which deployment are you most interested in?" If they pick Private -> auto-route to compliance AE. If Dedicated with budget > $25k -> priority AE.
Theo Brooks: Microcopy suggestions (short):
- Hosted hero: "API access in minutes — self-serve trial, no credit card required."
- Dedicated hero: "Reserved capacity with predictable p99 and burst options."
- Private hero: "Private deployment (VPC / on-prem) with KMS & audit logs."
Also add a footnote near Private: "Contact us for compliance packages (SOC2, HIPAA, FedRAMP)."
Liam O'Connor: Social cadence: Preheat (Day -2): benchmark teaser + webinar CTA; Launch (Day 0): hero + link to try/estimate/request demo; Follow-up (Day 3): deep-dive blog on Dedicated sizing; Day 6: webinar reminder + gating. Need 2x short X variants per day.
Carmen Li: Conversion experiments: A/B test Dedicated CTA text ("Estimate capacity" vs "Reserve compute") and Hosted CTA color (gold vs blue). Track click-through -> form submit -> SFDC lead mapping.
Eli Novak: Note for benchmark cards: always include model name, sequence length, and test date. Example microcopy under the stat: "Tested with open-medium, 2k seq, avg across 5 runs."
Samira Khan: Action items:
- Eli: benchmark numbers + one-liner methodology + 2 sample charts (due Mon)
- Theo: finalize routing snippet for ops + SFDC queue mapping (due Mon)
- Samira: finalize CTA microcopy + form field list for each path (due Tue)
- Liam: social copy drafts (4 x short variants) + image suggestions (due Tue)
- Carmen: open landing copy PR once CTAs locked (target Wed)
If anything blocks, drop notes here or ping me DM.
Theo Brooks: small UX note: on the public page, label the third path as "Private deployment (VPC / on-prem)" — don't leave it as just "Private". Reduces support questions.
Liam O'Connor: For the webinar reg form include a checkbox "I'd like a pre-webinar sizing consult" for Dedicated leads; that should create a task for Solutions to reach out.
Carmen Li: thanks team. Scheduling a 20m async review Tue AM. I'll loop in growth-ops once routing is finalized.
